I'd like to stay within a sensible budget, what are my best options?
If you are looking for sensible, budget-friendly options that deliver exceptional quality and real-wood beauty, here are some of our best choices:
1. Popup ($5.50/sq ft) – A Stuga staff favorite! Built with a clever hardwood veneer and an extra-tough, water-resistant matte acrylic finish, it offers all the warmth of natural wood at a very accessible price point.
2. High Five ($5.59/sq ft) – Part of our waterproof Rebels collection, giving you incredible strength (3-5x stronger than traditional hardwood) for busy homes.
3. Zig Zag ($6.19/sq ft) – A rich, durable European walnut floor that brings timeless warmth and elegance on a budget.
4. Tivoli ($8.39/sq ft) – One of our most accessible Scandinavian white oak floors from The Icons collection, featuring a classic matte finish.
